series.label: US median new-home price
series.note: US median new-home price: Census median sales price of new houses sold (FRED MSPUS, nominal dollars, quarterly) from 1963. From 1963 the series covers new homes only; the earlier part is a rescaled all-home index. For existing-home price changes see the US home price index vs gold row.

series.label: Who owns the federal debt (and the Fed's balance sheet)
series.note: Ownership split: approximate quarter end. Fed stocks use the last Wednesday in the quarter-end month. Foreign holders are US Treasury TIC estimates of foreign holdings of Treasury securities at quarter-end months (official vs private/other). Other domestic holders are a residual: total debt minus government accounts minus Fed Treasuries minus TIC foreign holdings. TIC and Treasury/Fed debt definitions differ, so the residual is approximate. Non-Treasury Fed assets are NOT federal debt. Dollar-equivalent gold, not gold owned.

Points after each row's monthly/quarterly history are genuine completed-week observations (Friday-labeled; at least 3 business days for averages). Priced in gold using the same week's World Gold Council weekly average. Stocks (debt, Fed balance sheet) are end-of-week or source-published weekly observations, not averages. Nothing is forward-filled from monthly data; rows without a weekly source keep their existing cadence.

No free weekly silver source exists, so weekly points carry no oz Ag value: silver denomination of weekly points ends at the last monthly point, and row-level oz Ag keeps the last monthly conversion. Gold and USD denominations are genuine weekly.

historical_comparison_method.scope: Gold-denominated price rows with at least 24 valid observations. Rates, ratios, fixed indexes, gold itself and short histories have explicit unavailable reasons.
historical_comparison_method.percentile: Rounded percentage of historical time weight strictly below the latest valid value. A percentile is not a forecast, probability or expected return.
historical_comparison_method.weights: Each valid point receives the fractional-year gap to the next source point; final point receives 1/12 year; minimum weight 0.0001 year. Fractional year = year + (month-1)/12 + (day-1)/365. Same convention as the existing interactive model.
historical_comparison_method.median: First value in ascending value order whose cumulative time weight reaches half of all time weight.
historical_comparison_method.delta: 100 * (latest / median - 1). Negative means below, positive above. Not a change over time and not a year-average comparison.
historical_comparison_method.caveats: Available histories differ in start date and frequency and may contain proxies or approximate reconstructions. Preserve every existing series note and source convention alongside these comparisons. Gold-equivalent balance rows are not gold owned. Underlying data remain dated and are not real-time.
